node.statement: By def-routef-raw-factor-setting, rho_Delta_prime=min{rho_T,rho_prod}, rho_prod=rho_T, and rho_T is at most rho_theta=1/8 and at most 1/(4*(1+C_V)). Since C_A=20+(211/8)*C_theta>0 and bar_C_E=max{1,C_E}>=1, C_V=bar_C_E*C_A>=0; hence 0<=eta<=rho_Delta_prime implies eta<=rho_T, eta<=rho_prod, eta<=1/8, and C_V*eta<=C_V/(4*(1+C_V))<=1/4.
